Game Overview

In Three Points, the core idea is straightforward: challenge your reflexes in Three Points. Rotate the triangle swiftly to match falling colored balls with their bases. Master precision and timing while using power-ups like slow time, double points, and shields. Aim for the highest score and become the world record champion!
